messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-prefill OOMs detected on node gpu-eu-12 (eu-west-1). 12 container restarts in last 3m. Auto-pager triggered.
alice_sre: seeing it, joining now. Paging oncall @bob_runtime.
bob_runtime: oncall here, joining bridge. Initial glance: prefill OOMs correlated with very long chat history streams, TTL ~180s, prefill size ~1.2M chars for some requests. stack snippet shows CUDA OOM and then container SIGKILL.
bob_runtime: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17T02:15:12Z] runtime: prefill allocate KV cache 14.8GiB -> cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[2026-03-17T02:15:12Z] kernel panic -> process killed (OOM)
```
carla_prodops: how many customers impacted / any 5xx spike in frontend?
dave_support: Support telemetry: ~18 unique API keys saw 500/502 between 02:14–02:18 UTC. Most are long-chat completions (>200k token equivalent). At least 2 paid accounts reported timeouts.
elaine_engineer: probable root: unbounded prefill for chat sessions bypassing prefill-trim due to new sticky-session feature. Could be regression from yesterday's routing change that left prefill bypass flag on.
alice_sre: immediate mitigation options?
bob_runtime: suggest (1) enable runtime prefill-trim policy globally, (2) route long-context requests to small-model fallback (quantized), (3) cordon + drain affected node, restart pods with reduced max_prefill_tokens.
carla_prodops: priority = P0 until confirmed <1% customer failure rate. Need customer impact note for CS and Sales.
dave_support: prepping a triage email draft. Will hold until we confirm mitigation.
elaine_engineer: commands to cordon/drain node and patch ds:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-eu-12
kubectl drain gpu-eu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl -n inference set env ds/serving-runtime MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=20000 --record
```
bob_runtime: rolling restart started on node group eu-gpu-pool-1, increasing replica set on fallback pool by +3 to absorb traffic. Also enabling prefix cache eviction aggressively.
alice_sre: applying prefill-trim flag now (feature flag: runtime_prefill_trim=on). Rolling through 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 6m.
incident-bot: feature-flag rollout: 10% -> success -> 50% -> success -> 100% -> success. No restarts observed after 02:24 UTC on rolled pods.
dave_support: customer impact update: reduced error rate to ~0.6% across keys. Notifying two affected customers with workaround: temporary session truncation and recommend smaller model.
carla_prodops: good. Can we add an emergency rule to rate-limit extremely long prefill (>100k tokens) to prevent recurrence?
bob_runtime: added a temporary ingress rule: reject prefill requests with prefill_token_count > 100000 with 413 + helpful payload. Pushed as emergency hotfix to gateway.
elaine_engineer: created PR to revert the sticky-session bypass for prefill trimming. Will land after quick review. Also added extra logging for prefill token counts.
alice_sre: handing off to @bob_runtime for oncall rotation. I'll take post-incident summary + customer comms draft.
bob_runtime: taking handoff. Current status: node cordoned/drained, pods stable, error rate down to 0.4%, emergency rate-limit active, fallback pool scaled. Will monitor for 30m and then begin postmortem.
dave_support: CS draft ready, sending to legal/ops review then customers.
carla_prodops: next steps: RCA, timeline, rollback diff, and engineering owners for permanent cap/guardrails. Assigning to @elaine_engineer and @bob_runtime.
alice_sre: thanks team. If error rate creeps back above 1% re-pager. Closing live mitigation thread, leaving monitoring on. :white_check_mark:
